name: Clever Leader
body:
Your council and wise words draw people to you.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership, Int 13

Benefit(s): You add your Intelligence bonus to your leadership score for the purpose of determining how many followers you gain from the Leadership feat. This also allows you to use your Intelligence in place of your Charisma for prerequisite purposes for other feats that also require Leadership.
